sentences.text:
In Re: Subhasish Ghosh & Ors vs Smt. Debosree Ghosh on 16
October, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
16.10.2023 In The High Court At Calcutta Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction jb.
C.R.R. 3790 of 2023 In Re: Subhasish Ghosh & Ors.
vs. Smt. Debosree Ghosh , (Nee Sarkar) & Anr.

Re: An application under Section 482 of the Code of
Criminal Procedure.

Mr. Aman Baid
 - For the Petitioners

The petitioners have prayed for expeditious disposal of the Dumdum Police Station Case No. 276 of 2018 dated 21.03.2018 under Sections 498A/406/376 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the revisional application upon the opposite party No. 2 through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta.

The petitioner is also directed to serve copy of the revisional application upon the opposite party No.
1 by speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit of service on the next date fixed for hearing.
Let the matter be listed under the heading 'To be Mentioned' on 17th November, 2023.
All concerned parties shall act in terms of the copy of the order downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
